propositions: Completion verifier performs 84-158 redundant file read/search requests per run due to lack of upfront file context, with 67-82% of distinct file reads already declared in file_impact but fetched agentically
Close-gate verification (graph=False) must prefetch only the closing ticket's own file_impact, not descendant subtree, to honour the graph=False contract and avoid runaway discovery loops

Prefetched content section must be bounded (30k tokens aggregate, 12k per-file), with skeleton compression for large files (>500 lines), and included in physical_context_ceiling accounting so oversize prefetch is trimmed rather than overflowing

Prefetch is opt-in via new assemble_context(prefetch=None) parameter; generic review callers (_review_ticket_impl, review_workflows) pass None to remain byte-identical and avoid injecting prefetch into non-completion contexts

Recovery successor runs receive prefetch via byte-stable cache_prefix position in system_prompt so it cache-reads across batches; trusted confirm-working-tree rule must be co-located in both completion_verifier.md and _EVIDENCE_SYSTEM before volatile markers
Live A/B demonstrates >20% reduction in verifier request count (f6fc 56%, e6a0 30%) with equal verdict class when prefetch enabled, eliminating over-exploration excursions in baseline discovery
